title: open-items-v1
description: Schema for plan-returns/<run_id>/<plan_id>/open-items.json. Worker accumulates open items across all packs in a plan into this single file (one per plan). Coordinator processes the items at Plan boundary — triage by tag: out-of-scope → backlog / next plan; needs-evaluation → independent judgment; bug → file ticket or fix immediately. Tag set aligned with pack-returns-v1.json .open_items[].tag (Plan 002 Pack 2.7).

items.description: Accumulated open items across all packs in the plan. Empty array allowed (no items found).

tag.description: Triage tag — same enum as pack-returns-v1.json .open_items[].tag.

pack_id.description: Pack identifier where the item was surfaced (e.g. '5.3').

finding.description: Short human-readable description; include 'where found' + 'impact judgment'.

suggested_action.description: Optional suggested action for the Coordinator (e.g. 'file ticket', 'add to next plan').
